gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns: p5 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints Debt Service and Capital Projects columns that have no schedule. Debt Service: Taxes - property 3,086,885 + Taxes - city sales 668,361 + Development contribution 439,557 + Highway allocation funds 228,831 + Interest 22,115 = 4,445,749 (printed Total revenues). Capital Projects: Taxes - property 3,644,228 + Taxes - city sales 359,603 + Taxes - city sales additional 1/2% 1,108,408 + Licenses, permits and fees 1,247,685 + City of LaVista - fire agreement 74,500 + Federal grants 28,306 + Other intergovernmental 3,106 + Highway allocation funds 252,447 + Interest 225,387 + Miscellaneous 5,064 = 6,948,734 (printed Total revenues). 64,185,434 + 4,445,749 + 6,948,734 = 75,579,917. (2) Different basis, no fix: the schedules on pp9-13 are 'Budget and Actual - Budgetary Basis' and their actuals differ from the GAAP fund columns on p5: General p9 Total revenues 59,058,061 vs p5 General 29,588,079 (+29,469,982; e.g. Taxes - city sales 31,635,831 vs 2,297,264); ARPA p10 1,825,788 (Federal grants 1,811,558 + Interest income 14,230) vs p5 ARPA 14,230 (+1,811,558); Keno Lottery p11 719,702 vs p5 726,446 (-6,744); Papillion Landing p12 2,214,771 vs p5 2,209,727 (+5,044); Papio Bay p13 367,112 = p5 367,112. 29,469,982 + 1,811,558 - 6,744 + 5,044 = 31,279,840; 75,579,917 - 31,279,840 = 44,300,077 = statement total. After the fix the schedule stays 31,279,840 above the statement, all budgetary-basis difference.
